Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 7

Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly concluded that the Adam Smith Awards administered by Treasury Today are the relevant prize named after the author of "The Wealth of Nations." The Planner overlooked the verified information from earlier steps that the Adam Smith Prize is awarded by the University of Cambridge, specifically by the Faculty of Economics for Part IIB of the Economics Tripos. The Planner failed to distinguish between different prizes named after Adam Smith and prioritized the wrong source, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
